verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents a GraphQL API with self-serve API keys copied from the Integrations section and standard bearer-token auth. It offers `transcripts` (list and filter) and `transcript` (by ID) queries, schema introspection, and Super Admin access to query all team data, so scripts can pull data from every meeting. Webhooks can trigger fetches when processing completes. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that summary and action-item fields are returned by the API (the evidence only shows them as product features), and independent or hands-on corroboration of scripted retrieval.
